BraTS2021_00000.prompt:
You are a neuroradiologist reviewing a brain MRI. A prior automated segmentation and feature extraction pipeline has analyzed the patient's pre-operative MRI and extracted the following structured findings:

## Structured Imaging Findings

- Lesion laterality: LEFT hemisphere (-18.3 mm from brain midline)
- Primary location: frontal lobe
- Whole tumor volume (including edema): 57.3 cm³
- Tumor core volume (necrosis + enhancing): 44.5 cm³
- Enhancing tumor volume: 32.7 cm³
- Necrotic core: present (11.7 cm³, central)
- Peritumoral edema: mild (12.8 cm³)
- Enhancement pattern: heterogeneous
- Mass effect: possible

## Your Task

Based SOLELY on these structured findings (do not speculate beyond what the features support), provide your diagnostic assessment.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object in exactly this format, with no preamble or text outside the JSON:

{
  "diagnosis": "<one of: glioblastoma, low_grade_glioma, meningioma, metastasis, lymphoma, abscess, other>",
  "confidence": <float between 0.0 and 1.0>,
  "laterality": "<LEFT, RIGHT, BILATERAL, or MIDLINE>",
  "lobe": "<frontal, temporal, parietal, occipital, cerebellar, brainstem, or deep>",
  "grade": "<high or low>",
  "enhancement": "<ring, solid, homogeneous, heterogeneous, none>",
  "key_evidence": ["<finding 1>", "<finding 2>", "<finding 3>"],
  "differentials": [
    {"diagnosis": "<alternative>", "discriminator": "<what info would rule in/out>"},
    {"diagnosis": "<alternative>", "discriminator": "<what info would rule in/out>"}
  ]
}

differentials.discriminator: absence of necrosis and less heterogeneous enhancement
typically smaller tumor core volume and less necrosis
